upstream.description: An open-source video editor built for agents. Edits become code, code becomes video.

classification.analysis: Diffusion Studio is an open-source desktop video editor (Electron + SolidJS, with a headless "koota" ECS runtime) built to be driven by coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor: every edit is represented as JSX composition code, and editing the canvas updates the code while editing the code redraws the canvas. It ships a `dapi` CLI and an `/editor` agent skill so an agent can inspect footage (probe, transcribe, waveform, filmstrip), generate images/video/voiceover assets inline via `generate.*`, cut/caption/color-grade a timeline, and render the final video, with the finished project remaining fully editable by a human afterward. It targets people who want to produce motion graphics, social clips, and edited video by prompting an AI agent rather than manual timeline editing; built by the YC-backed Diffusion Studio Inc.

use_cases.title: Let an AI coding agent cut and caption raw footage into a finished video
Generate a promo or explainer video with AI-generated images, video, and voiceover
Clip highlights from a long video into a vertical social-media cut
Drive video editing from a CLI or JSX code instead of a manual timeline
